summary: Iteration 55: verified 3 features via Playwright — (1) Admin in-app Attendance Rules editor: rules-edit visible only to admin, version bump shows amber re-sign warning, revert clears it, editing body-0 (append TEST_MARKER, save with same version) reflects in read view, add-section then remove-section + version restore to 2026-09 works. (2) Save Guard everywhere: TopSaveButton data-dirty toggle + Esc discard-confirm behaviour confirmed on Fleets (ff-top-save), Institutions InstForm (inst-top-save) + EscortForm (escort-top-save), and MyLeaves ApplyForm (leave-top-save). Devices approve dialog not exercised because no pending devices existed (page loaded without error, per spec). (3) Coach access to Tasks: sidebar shows 'Tasks' link (/tasks), all 3 tabs render (today/todos/checklists), 'Everyone' scope on To-dos correctly shows both coach's own to-do (MY TO-DOS) and Exec Test User's assigned to-do — shared team board confirmed. Staff (dar.test) regression: no Tasks link in sidebar, /tasks API endpoints return 403 with toast 'Tasks are available to executives and coaches only'. All flows PASS. Rules version left at 2026-09 as required.

issues: Frontend does not guard the /tasks route for non-exec/non-coach users — the Tasks page shell (tabs + inputs) renders and the API 403 fires afterwards with a toast. Sidebar link is correctly hidden, but a member who types /tasks directly briefly sees the tab shell. Minor: ideally the route should redirect to /disabled-feature (like other role-gated pages) instead of rendering the shell.

action_items: (Non-blocking) Consider wrapping /tasks route in a role guard so members without executive/coach/admin get redirected to the disabled-feature page instead of seeing the tab shell before the API 403s.
(Non-blocking, carried from iter54) MemberForm still emits <option>-inside-<span> hydration warning.
critical_code_review_comments: useDirtyForm.js snapshots the entire form via JSON.stringify on every render — fine for these small forms but a hot path if forms grow.

useEscape.js intentionally blurs focused input on first Esc; tests must blur first to trigger the discard-confirm on the same key press. This is documented behaviour but a subtle UX pitfall for users typing in a field.

Rules editor 'Save' button is at the bottom only — for consistency with the 'top-save' pattern applied elsewhere in this iteration, RulesEditor could also expose a top-save with dirty-glow. Currently it lacks the dirty indicator that all other modals now share.
TodosTab / ChecklistsTab render for staff (403 toast only) before the guard kicks in — a client-side role check on /tasks would avoid the wasted round-trip and flicker.
